sources.source_type: Official company IR page, direct audio/mpeg file (no registration, no WAF cookie issue once warmed up via browser)
sources.notes: ingest.py's own Playwright IR-page scraper for 2382 (PW-IR) reported 'No video URLs found' on both the Chinese and English financials_icp.aspx pages despite the video icon being visibly present in a real browser session (chrome-devtools) - likely a headless/rendering or JS-interaction gap in the scraper, not a genuine absence of media. User supplied the direct IR page URL and pointed out the 1Q26 and 3Q25 rows specifically had video icons. Direct download required the site's bot-protection (Uzma/Reblaze-style) cookies obtained from a real browser session; a bare curl request without cookies returned an HTML challenge page instead of the audio/mpeg stream. Saved as data/2382/2382_2026_q1.mp3; uploaded to GitHub Release audio-files.

notes: This event was one of two 2382 quarters (2026 Q1, 2025 Q4) with no audio/FIN/GT despite having IR presentation materials. For 2025 Q4, the company's own IR page (both Chinese and English) shows NO video icon for the 4Q25 row -- and, on inspection, ALSO no video icon for 4Q22/4Q23/4Q24, indicating Quanta structurally does not record/publish a Q4 earnings call webcast (as opposed to a discoverable-but-missed source). This is a company-level pattern, not a data-collection gap, and should be treated as a permanent 'no audio available' case for Q4 quarters unless a future quarter breaks the pattern.
